failure.summary: The netlist generator never compiled: gen_full.py ended with a Python SyntaxError (unmatched bracket) and the agent spent the remaining steps re-reading and patching a 400+ line generator; gates.txt was never replaced, so the grader ran the untouched example file, which prints N/2 (882 for 1764). The trial hit the 7200 s timeout at step 24 with the syntax error still present.

evidence_quotes.quote:
python3 -m py_compile /app/gen_full.py 2>&1
  File "/app/gen_full.py", line 228
    emit("out%d = out%d & out%d" % (r, ~counter[i]), C0))  # wrong
SyntaxError: unmatched ')'

eq0 = nw()
  cur = C1
  for i in range(17):
      r = nw()
      emit("out%d = out%d & out%d" % (r, ~counter[i]), C0))  # wrong

candidates.why_relevant: Its step 2 is 'write a minimal script in one heredoc, run the evaluator, and if a syntax error appears rewrite the whole script rather than patching the math'; here the model rewrote/patch-cycled a monolithic generator and /app/sim was never used as the gate.
Card for failing local checks: fix the first traceback line and rerun the check; the model inspected the file instead of fixing the reported syntax error and re-running py_compile/sim.

pending_relevant.why_relevant: Pending closed-plan card; a named acceptance command (sim 208 == 377) would have made 'generator still has a SyntaxError' an obvious blocker to fix first.

skill_use.detail: Only the remote-asset-recovery card was opened, which does not apply (sim.c and gcc are local). The fix-failing-check and evaluator-iteration cards were never opened; the agent verified with py_compile once, hit the syntax error, and then spent its last step re-reading the file rather than fixing it.

verdict.rationale: The deliverable was never generated (generator had a syntax error) and the original example gates.txt remained in place, so every graded value was N/2; the model had a working local oracle and 2 h but did not converge.
